adminUsdt.title: USDT payments
adminUsdt.copy: Receive USDT directly into your wallets.
adminUsdt.name: Display name
adminUsdt.rateHint: Each order keeps its original rate.
adminUsdt.quoteHint: Three decimal places. Unique amounts can add up to 0.099 USDT; TXB credit stays fixed.
adminUsdt.saved: Settings saved. Network readiness is being checked.
adminUsdt.enableNetwork: Accept new payments on this network
adminUsdt.addressesHint: One address per line. Old unpaid quotes remain monitored. Amount reservations are never reused.
adminUsdt.noEndpoints: Add a server and receiving address to enable this network.
adminUsdt.keepSecret: Stored securely; leave blank to keep
adminUsdt.wsHint: EVM can use its WS RPC URL. Solana needs an HTTP RPC companion.
adminUsdt.concurrencyHint: One shared limit across RPC, indexer, probe, reconnect, and WS requests.
adminUsdt.reviewHint: Auto-credit an unpaid order only when the network and address match and the amount is exact or up to 0.001 USDT short. Review ambiguous matches manually.

reviewReasons.USDT_ALREADY_CREDITED: The matching order was already credited
